plainLanguage: Hutto most likely uses the 2021 International Residential Code, but we could not confirm the ordinance this time. Most new homes are in single-family (SF) districts or planned developments that set their own setbacks. Until verified, plan for about a 25 ft front setback, 5 ft sides and 20 ft rear. Hutto sits on some of the most expansive clay in Texas, so a geotechnical report and engineered slab are expected. Your water may come from the city or a water supply corporation, which changes tap fees.
